alerts.headline: Gale Watch issued November 21 at 2:35AM EST until November 23 at 10:00AM EST by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.areas: Cape Cod Bay; Vineyard Sound; Buzzards Bay; Rhode Island Sound
alerts.description: * WHAT...South winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and seas 6 to 9 feet possible. * WHERE...In Massachusetts coastal waters, Cape Cod Bay, Vineyard Sound and Buzzards Bay. In Rhode Island coastal waters, Rhode Island Sound. * WHEN...From Sunday evening through Monday morning. * IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
alerts.instruction: Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible hazardous conditions. Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
